metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over Wolf Volcano on Isabela Island brighter on January 7, 2022 then January 6 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (DNB) for nighttime brightness - Collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" or daily if available - Actually, for specific dates, I should use daily: "NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1" (VIIRS Daily Gridded Day Night Band) - Location: Wolf Volcano, Isabela Island, Galápagos (-0.02°N, -91.35°W approximately) - Dates: January 6, 2022 and January 7, 2022 2. Masking strategy: - For nighttime lights, we want to measure brightness directly - May need to check quality flags, but primarily measure radiance values - No cloud masking needed for nighttime lights 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid zero would mean no nighttime brightness (possible) - Need to check if images exist for both dates (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after any quality filtering (C2) - Check if calculation returns valid numbers (C3) - Compare: if Jan 7 > Jan 6, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const wolfVolcano = ee.Geometry.Point([-91.35, 0.02]); const date1 = '2022-01-06'; const date2 = '2022-01-07'; // 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Daily Nighttime Lights const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1') .filterBounds(wolfVolcano) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1') .filterBounds(wolfVolcano) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 6 Images: ${size1}, Jan 7 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Get images and measure nighttime radiance const img1 = ee.Image(col1.first()); const img2 = ee.Image(col2.first()); // Use DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m band const band = 'DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m'; // 4. Calculate pixel counts to detect C2 const count1 = await img1.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: wolfVolcano.buffer(5000), scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band).getInfo(); const count2 = await img2.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: wolfVolcano.buffer(5000), scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band).getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 6 Pixels: ${count1}, Jan 7 Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for measurement.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean radiance values const val1 = await img1.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: wolfVolcano.buffer(5000), scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band).getInfo(); const val2 = await img2.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: wolfVolcano.buffer(5000), scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band).getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 6 Radiance: ${val1}, Jan 7 Radiance: ${val2}`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (val1 === null || val2 === null || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Brightness comparison: Jan7(${val2.toFixed(4)}) vs Jan6(${val1.toFixed(4)})`); if (val2 > val1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
